reason: Customer forgot password and cannot log in; covered by FAQ F01 (forgotten password reset via app.roosterly.nl/login). Self-service workaround available.

verification.back_translation: Hi Marloes, no problem. Go to app.roosterly.nl/login, click "Forgot password" and enter your email address. You will receive a link to set a new password; the link is valid for 60 minutes. If you do not receive an email within 10 minutes, check your spam folder. Good luck!

Customer requests a dark mode for the app. This is a feature request not in the FAQ; per F10, it should be pointed to the public roadmap at roadmap.roosterly.nl for voting. No mandatory escalation applies.

verification.back_translation: Thanks for your suggestion! We read every idea. You can find the dark mode on our public roadmap at roadmap.roosterly.nl, where you can also vote on ideas. Unfortunately, we cannot promise a delivery date.

reason: General how-to question about adding an employee, covered by FAQ F02 (Team → Medewerker toevoegen, then Uitnodigen). No mandatory escalation applies.

verification.back_translation: Good morning Anouk, adding a new employee works like this: in Roosterly, go to Team → Add employee, enter the name, email address and contract hours, and click Invite. The employee will then receive an email to install the app. Please note: you only pay for active employees. Good luck with the start on Monday!

Customer reports that night shifts are duplicated in the Nmbrs payroll export, and a follow-up asks for news before the payroll run closes on Thursday. This is an unresolved technical issue affecting one customer's payroll, and no FAQ point covers it, so it must go to a human.

Customer reports a published rota disappearing for the third time, leaving staff at shifts that no longer exist. No FAQ answer covers this. The customer also threatens to cancel service (zeggen we op), which is a mandatory handoff.

Customer asks whether hours can be sent to Loket.nl. Covered by F04: the Loket.nl integration is part of the Plus plan, and CSV export is available. Customer is on Basis. No mandatory escalation applies.

verification.back_translation: Good day, Thank you for your question. Roosterly can export approved hours to Loket.nl. This integration is part of the Plus subscription. With the Basic subscription you can export the hours as a CSV file. If you want to use the Loket.nl integration, you can upgrade under Settings → Subscription. The new price applies from the next invoice. The Plus subscription costs €6 per active employee per month, excl. VAT. You set up the integration itself under Settings → Integrations → Payroll. There you export per pay period (week, four weeks or month). Kind regards, The Roosterly team

reason: Customer requests a webhook when a shift is published to sync with an external planning tool. This is a new feature not in the app. Per F10, feature requests are directed to the public roadmap, where the customer can vote, with no delivery date promised.

verification.back_translation: Thank you for your question. Webhooks are not currently available in Roosterly. We have noted your request as a feature idea. You can vote for it and follow its progress on our public roadmap at roadmap.roosterly.nl. We cannot promise a delivery date for individual requests. Thank you for helping us improve Roosterly.

verification.back_translation: Hi! You can find your invoices in Roosterly under Settings → Subscription → Invoices (Instellingen → Abonnement → Facturen). There you can download them, for example the Q3 overview for your bookkeeper. Invoices are also emailed every month on the 1st. Good luck!

Customer asks whether the app is available in German. FAQ F08 confirms the web and mobile apps are available in Dutch, English and German, and each user can choose their language under Profiel → Taal. Covered by FAQ, no escalation rule applies.

verification.back_translation: Yes, Roosterly is also available in German. Both the web app and the mobile app support Dutch, English and German. Each employee can set the language themselves: under Profile → Taal (Profile → Language). Kind regards, Your Roosterly team

reason: Customer asks how to upgrade from Basis to Plus and when the new price applies. Covered by F05: upgrade under Instellingen → Abonnement, new price applies from the next invoice. Pricing query, no urgency, no mandatory escalation.

verification.back_translation: Hi, you can upgrade to Plus via Settings → Subscription (Settings → Subscription). The new price applies from the next invoice. reason: The customer asks where their data is stored. FAQ F09 covers this: data is stored in the EU (Frankfurt, Germany) under a data processing agreement, which can be downloaded under Instellingen → Juridisch. This is not a GDPR personal data request, so no mandatory escalation applies.

verification.back_translation: Dear customer, thank you for your question. All of our data is stored in the EU, in Frankfurt (Germany), and processed under a data processing agreement. You can download this agreement via Settings → Legal. Kind regards, the Roosterly support team

General how-to question about shift swapping, covered by FAQ F03: employees offer the swap via 'Ruil aanbieden' in the app, colleagues with the same role can accept, and the manager approves under Rooster → Verzoeken.

verification.back_translation: Hello, your employees can swap shifts with each other: The person opens the shift in the app and taps "Ruil aanbieden" (Offer swap). Colleagues with the same role can accept the swap. Afterwards, the manager approves the swap under Rooster → Verzoeken (Rota → Requests). Manager approval is enabled by default and can be disabled under Instellingen → Rooster (Settings → Rota). Kind regards, Your Roosterly team
